source_section: New JSX Transform is now required
text: React 19 requires applications to use the modern JSX transform.
ReactDOM.findDOMNode has been removed and applications should replace calls with DOM refs.
reason: Verify calls to the removed function.

text: Access to element.ref is deprecated; code should read the ref from element.props.ref.
reason: Verify property access in application code.

text: React 19 deprecates react-test-renderer and recommends migrating tests to another library.
reason: Verify test code and imports that use the package.

text: React 19 no longer distributes UMD builds; script-based deployments should use an ESM CDN.
reason: Verify package loading and deployment setup.

text: The chat.instructionsFilesLocations setting controls where VS Code looks for instruction files.
VS Code now requires extension signature verification on Linux as well as Windows and macOS.
reason: Verify extension installation policy and deployment environment.

source_section: Default syntax highlighting for env files
text: Files whose names match the .env pattern now receive INI syntax highlighting by default.
reason: Verify editor presentation of these files.

text: The Node extension host supports ESM extensions when package.json sets type to module.
reason: Verify extension module code and imports.

text: The extension API can now encode a string to bytes and decode bytes with a selected encoding.

source_section: CSS Container Queries flat tree lookup
text: Container queries now inspect flat-tree ancestors in shadow DOM and may alter the selected CSS container.
Chrome preserves the placement of bare declarations following nested CSS rules during parsing.
Chrome can use shared compression dictionaries and enterprise HTTPS inspection infrastructure may have compatibility issues.
reason: Verify enterprise network and policy configuration.

text: IndexedDB requests now raise NotFoundError when the backing data file is missing from disk.
reason: Verify stored-data recovery and persistence handling.

text: Scroll containers without focusable children are keyboard focusable by default in Chrome 130.
reason: Verify keyboard interaction and accessibility behavior.
